title: First Day Home
desc: We wrapped you in a soft white blanket and brought you home. The whole house felt different — warmer, fuller, more alive.
story: After two nights in the hospital, we finally drove home with you snug in your car seat. Dad kept looking in the rear-view mirror every 30 seconds. Mum held your tiny hand the whole way. When we walked through the front door for the first time as a family of three, we both cried. Happy, overwhelmed, completely in love tears.
